versions.changelog: v1.4.0 — HTTP REST API: --listen flag starts zero-dependency REST server exposing shared memory over HTTP. GET /health, /keys, /count, /stats, /schemas, /read/<agent>/<key>. POST /write (with optional --schema validation), /cleanup. CORS headers. Stdlib only, no pip install needed.

v1.3.0 — SQLite production shared memory backend: WAL-mode concurrent R/W, ACID transactions, --migrate-to-sqlite migration tool, --keys, --count-by-agent, --compact utilities. Full backward compatibility with file backend. No pip deps required.
v1.2.0: Structured memory schemas with validation, health probes + rate limits, workflow DAG templates (5 pipeline patterns), schema validation bug fix
